summary: Thinking and speech support power and transformation. This cooperative pattern asks you to use clear thinking and depth with awareness.
body: Thinking and speech support power and transformation. This cooperative pattern asks you to use clear thinking and depth with awareness. Persuasive depth and a talent for getting at hidden information. The connection is available when you choose to use it; it works best through deliberate practice. In practice, this can show up through thinking and speech, power and transformation, and the choices you make when mental noise or control starts running the room.
gift: The gift is clear thinking, depth, and a more conscious way to work with thinking and speech and power and transformation.
shadow: The shadow is mental noise, control, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let thinking and speech and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Sales, persuasion, research, and anything requiring depth and force of message.
do: Name how thinking and speech and power and transformation are both involved
Turn clear thinking and depth into one concrete choice
dont: Let mental noise make the decision
Ignore the needs of thinking and speech or power and transformation
